title: Museum of the Gulf Coast

services.name: School Tours
services.desc: The Museum of the Gulf Coast offers FREE school tours to students third through 12th grade year-round. All tours are led by a docent guide and last approximately 1-1/2 hours. The standard museum tour includes two floors of permanent exhibits in addition to our featured temporary exhibitions. If you would like a specific area highlighted on your tour, please let the tour coordinator know. PLEASE NOTE: Tours are based upon docent and staff availability. To ensure a date and docent availability we require that school groups schedule tours in advance. For our busy spring season, it is recommended that tours are scheduled as early as possible. ADMISSION Adults - $8 Senior Citizens (62+) - $6
